Title: About 1 in 20 Americans Deal With Sweaty Hands or Feet - Habits That Actually Help

Description:
Hyperhidrosis affects roughly 1 in 20 Americans, and hands and feet are two of the most common spots. Cotton socks, sealed shoes worn two days straight, and heavy caffeine intake all make it worse. Switch to moisture-wicking socks, rotate shoes so each pair gets 24-48 hours to dry, and try an aluminum chloride antiperspirant at night — see a dermatologist if it's disrupting daily life.
